reply_text:
One merge blocker:

*`src/plans.js:11` — quota conversion makes both paid-plan quotas zero.* JavaScript’s `<<` coerces values to signed 32-bit integers. `quotaKiB << 10` returns `0` for both team (200 GiB) and archive (2 TiB), so even a 1-byte upload to an empty paid account is rejected as “over quota.”

Use multiplication by `1024` instead, and add quota/upload regression tests for both paid plans before merging.

Confirmed on `3ebff74`. All four existing tests pass, but they miss this case. No code changed.
